name: Dark Council
summary: In Southshore, Magistrate Henry Maleb weighs a letter naming Nagaz and the Argus Wake. He fears they may threaten the land if allied with the Syndicate, and sends you to hunt Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages in the Uplands.

sections.title: Envoys in the Uplands
sections.body:
After Further Mysteries, Maleb tells you the letter came from Nagaz, who belongs to the Argus Wake. He does not know what the Argus Wake is, but fears an alliance with the Syndicate would make them a threat. So he wants Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages named in the letter found and killed. Bring him Nagaz’s head.

Search the Uplands, north of Strahnbrad, where the Syndicate is strongest. Maleb hopes the Argus Wake’s envoys are there.

sections.title: What Maleb Concludes
sections.body: Magistrate Henry Maleb is troubled that a group like the Argus Wake might run the Syndicate. Nagaz, he says, was only another’s servant. The Argus Wake’s reach may run deep across the continent, or even the whole world.

aliases: where to pick up dark council
faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore sends you after Nagaz. He read the letter you brought him.

faq.q: Where are Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages located?
faq.answer: Maleb tells you to search the Uplands, north of Strahnbrad, where the Syndicate is strongest.
Maleb does not know what the Argus Wake is. He knows only that Nagaz belongs to it, and that it must be a threat if allied with the Syndicate.
It follows Further Mysteries, when you brought the decrypted letter to Maleb.
